dialogue.content: 本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日は、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for being here today.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたので、はじめてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's our scheduled time, so shall we begin?

dialogue.content: お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: ご相談ありがとうございます。性別、年齢、あなた様をなんとお呼びしたらよろしのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out. May I ask your gender and age, and how you would like me to address you?

dialogue.content: あゆみと申します。30代前半、女です。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: My name is Ayumi. I'm a woman in my early 30s. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 早速ですが、あゆみ様本日の相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Let's get started then. Ayumi, could you tell me what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: もうすぐ結婚するのですが
dialogue.English: I'm getting married soon,

dialogue.content: これまで自分の母親に色々なことを相談していたのですが
dialogue.English: and up until now, I've always consulted my mother about various things,

dialogue.content: 彼と母の考えが違うことが多くて
dialogue.English: but my fiancé and my mother often have different opinions,

dialogue.content: 自分としてはどちらが良いのか迷うことがありまして困っています
dialogue.English: and I'm having trouble deciding which choice is better.

dialogue.content: まず、あゆみ様ご結婚おめでとうございます。
dialogue.English: First of all, Ayumi, congratulations on your upcoming marriage.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 彼と母親の考えが違い板挟みになって辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: It sounds painful to be caught in the middle between your fiancé's and your mother's differing views.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: どちらの話もわかるので
dialogue.English: I can understand both sides,

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。今の状況は、大変ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be a very difficult situation.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 彼氏様とは、どれぐらいお付き合いしたのですか？
dialogue.English: How long have you and your fiancé been dating?

dialogue.content: 友人として長い付き合いでしたが、
dialogue.English: We were friends for a long time,

dialogue.content: 付き合ったのは1年位です
dialogue.English: but we’ve been dating for about a year.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼氏様と母親は、どう言ったことが考えが違うのか詳しく教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me in more detail about the things your fiancé and your mother disagree on?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まず結婚式の件です
dialogue.English: First, it's about the wedding.

dialogue.content: 彼は写真だけで良いんじゃないと言っているのですが
dialogue.English: He says that just taking photos would be fine,

dialogue.content: 結婚式の件で写真とは何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Regarding the wedding, what do you mean by 'just photos'?

dialogue.content: 説明不足ですみません
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I didn't explain that clearly.

dialogue.content: ゆっくりで大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: It's alright, please take your time.

dialogue.content: 彼と一緒に写真を撮ってもらうことです
dialogue.English: I mean having photos taken of the two of us.

dialogue.content: そういうことですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for clarifying.

dialogue.content: タキシード、ドレスで
dialogue.English: In a tuxedo and dress,

dialogue.content: 和装で
dialogue.English: or in traditional Japanese attire.

dialogue.content: 母は少人数でも集まった方が良いんじゃないのと
dialogue.English: My mother thinks it would be better to have a small gathering,

dialogue.content: 彼の家族と顔合わせをした方が良いんじゃないのと言っています
dialogue.English: and that it's a good opportunity for our families to meet.

dialogue.content: 少人数とは、家族や親戚でしょうか？
dialogue.English: By a small gathering, do you mean family and relatives?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 友人を呼んでとなると
dialogue.English: If we were to invite friends,

dialogue.content: あの人呼んでこの人呼ばないとなると申し訳ないので
dialogue.English: it would feel awkward to invite some people and not others.

dialogue.content: 結婚式は、そうなりますよね。
dialogue.English: That can certainly be an issue with weddings, can't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 母親は、今のところ身内で結婚式をしたいということですよね？
dialogue.English: So for now, your mother would prefer a wedding with just family, is that right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんは、友人を呼んで結婚式を挙げたいということですよね？
dialogue.English: And your fiancé wants to have a wedding with friends invited, is that correct?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No,

dialogue.content: 彼は写真だけで良いんじゃないと言っています
dialogue.English: he says just taking photos would be fine.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたしました。そういうことですか。
dialogue.English: My apologies. I understand now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私の姉が写真のみで済ませてしまって
dialogue.English: My older sister only had photos taken,

dialogue.content: 母の気持ちもわかるのですが
dialogue.English: so I understand how my mother feels.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですか。
dialogue.English: Oh, is that so?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 結婚式は大切ですからね。
dialogue.English: A wedding is an important event, after all.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 他に、結婚式で何かありますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else regarding the wedding?

dialogue.content: 結婚式のことは
dialogue.English: Regarding the wedding,

dialogue.content: 他にありません
dialogue.English: there's nothing else.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、結婚式はいつ行なわれるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, when is the wedding planned for?

dialogue.content: コロナの影響で延期にしまして
dialogue.English: We've postponed it due to COVID,

dialogue.content: 写真のみにするのか
dialogue.English: so we haven't decided whether to just have photos taken,

dialogue.content: 食事会にするのか
dialogue.English: or to have a small dinner party.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか…大変な時期ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see... It's a difficult time, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 内容が決まっていない状況ですので
dialogue.English: Since none of the details are decided yet,

dialogue.content: 日程も決まっていません
dialogue.English: the date hasn't been set either.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: (This utterance is a filler and can be omitted for natural flow in English.)

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。まだ、何も決まってない状況ですか。
dialogue.English: I see. So nothing has been decided yet.

dialogue.content: 具体的には決まっていなくて
dialogue.English: Nothing specific has been decided,

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いのか
dialogue.English: and I'm not sure what the best thing to do is.

dialogue.content: 考えているところです
dialogue.English: (Translated in the previous utterance.)

dialogue.content: そうですよね。不安になりますよね。
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It must make you feel anxious.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お姉さんは、写真の結婚式でしたが、母親は何か言ってましたか？
dialogue.English: Your sister had a photos-only wedding; did your mother say anything about that?

dialogue.content: 式と披露宴はしてほしかったようです
dialogue.English: It seems she had wanted her to have a ceremony and a reception.

dialogue.content: そうですか。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あゆみ様は、お姉さんの結婚式をどのようにかんじましたか？
dialogue.English: Ayumi, how did you feel about your sister's wedding?

dialogue.content: 姉達が決めたことなので
dialogue.English: Since it was their decision,

dialogue.content: 特に何も思いませんでした
dialogue.English: I didn't have any strong feelings about it.

dialogue.content: そうですか。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼氏様は、写真の結婚式をどのように思っているのかくわしく聞かしてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me in more detail how your fiancé feels about a photo-only wedding?

dialogue.content: わざわざ人を招かなくても写真だけで良いんじゃないといった感じです。
dialogue.English: It's the feeling that there's no need to go to the trouble of inviting people, and that just photos would be fine.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 人前が恥ずかしいみたいです
dialogue.English: It seems he's shy in front of people.

dialogue.content: 今までの、話を要約してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はいお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: あゆみ様は、結婚の悩みで彼と母親の考えの違いで板挟みになっている。
dialogue.English: Ayumi, you're dealing with wedding concerns and feel caught in the middle between your fiancé's and your mother's differing opinions.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼氏様は、結婚式の件を写真だけで良いと言う。人前に出るのが恥ずかしい。しかし、母親は身内同士で結婚式を考えている。お姉様が、写真で済ませたというのもある。
dialogue.English: Your fiancé says that just photos are fine for the wedding, as he is shy in front of people. However, your mother is thinking of a ceremony with just family, partly because your older sister only had photos taken.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今、コロナウイルスの影響で結婚式が延期になってしまった。
dialogue.English: And currently, the wedding has been postponed due to the coronavirus.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: すみません。話が飛んでしまったのですが、あゆみ様は彼と母親の考えの違いで板挟みになっている状態。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I got a bit off track. You're in a situation where you're caught between your fiancé's and your mother's differing views.

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: Oh, no, it's alright.

dialogue.content: はじめに仰っていました
dialogue.English: You mentioned that at the beginning.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたしました。
dialogue.English: My apologies.

dialogue.content: とんでもないです
dialogue.English: Not at all.

dialogue.content: このように要約したのですが、よろしかったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does this summary sound accurate to you?

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: あゆみ様が、一番解決したいことは何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What is the most important thing you would like to resolve, Ayumi?

dialogue.content: 解決したいことですか
dialogue.English: What I'd like to resolve...

dialogue.content: どちらの言い分もわかるのですが
dialogue.English: I understand both of their perspectives,

dialogue.content: 自分でもどうして良いかわからないです
dialogue.English: but I'm not sure what I should do myself.

dialogue.content: 母の気分を損ねたくないですし
dialogue.English: I don't want to hurt my mother's feelings,

dialogue.content: 彼の意見も尊重したいです
dialogue.English: and I also want to respect my fiancé's opinion.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。どちらの言い分も尊重したいですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You want to respect both of their views, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あゆみ様は、結婚式を挙げるならどのようにお考えか聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: If you were to have a wedding, Ayumi, what would you personally prefer?

dialogue.content: 私は何もしなくて良いと思っていました
dialogue.English: I actually thought we didn't need to do anything at all.

dialogue.content: ドレスを着たいとかもなく
dialogue.English: I don't have any particular desire to wear a wedding dress or anything like that.

dialogue.content: あゆみ様は、そのように考えているのですか。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel about it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼氏様と母親は、ご存知でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do your fiancé and your mother know this?

dialogue.content: 婚姻届を出して新しい生活が始まっただけで十分です
dialogue.English: For me, just filing the marriage registration and starting our new life together is enough.

dialogue.content: 彼は知っています
dialogue.English: He knows.

dialogue.content: 母には話していないです
dialogue.English: I haven't told my mother.

dialogue.content: そうねんですね。彼は知っているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So he knows.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼様は、どのように考えているのですか？
dialogue.English: And how does your fiancé feel about that?

dialogue.content: 恐らくですが
dialogue.English: I'm not completely sure, but I think

dialogue.content: 写真くらいは撮って
dialogue.English: he'd like to at least take photos

dialogue.content: 思い出としたい感じでしょうか
dialogue.English: to have them as a memory.

dialogue.content: 彼氏様は、そのような感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: So that’s the sense you get from him.

dialogue.content: よく一緒に写真を撮っていますので
dialogue.English: We often take photos together,

dialogue.content: その延長だと思います
dialogue.English: so I think this is just an extension of that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: (This utterance is a filler and can be omitted for natural flow in English.)

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。素敵な写真がたくさんあって、いいですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's lovely that you have so many wonderful photos together.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: このことを、彼氏様以外に誰かに相談しましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you discussed this with anyone besides your fiancé?

dialogue.content: 姉には話しています
dialogue.English: I've spoken with my sister about it.

dialogue.content: お姉さんは、何か言ってましたか？
dialogue.English: And what did she say?

dialogue.content: ごめんねと言っていました
dialogue.English: She said she was sorry.

dialogue.content: 私がちゃんとしなかったからと
dialogue.English: She said it was because she hadn't done things 'properly' herself.

dialogue.content: そういうことですか。そんなことないと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I see. I don't think that's the case at all.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: (This utterance is a filler and can be omitted for natural flow in English.)

dialogue.content: 今日は、そろそろお時間なので、また、改めてご相談いただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: We're almost out of time for today. Would it be alright if we continued this in our next session?

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日は、結婚について相談しました。コロナウイルスの影響で、結婚式が延期になりましたが本当に幸せな結婚式が挙げれるように願っています。
dialogue.English: Today we discussed your wedding plans. Although the ceremony has been postponed due to the coronavirus, I truly hope you’ll be able to have a joyful celebration when the time comes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: (ロールプレイを終了します。本日は、ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (This concludes the role-play. Thank you for your time today.)
